description: Change a status page incident's title, type, status pages or affected services. The pages show the change right away; subscribers are not notified. To tell them something, post an update.

add_components.description: Services to mark as affected: their UUIDs from get_status_page (mon_..., comp_... or agt_... for servers).

add_status_pages.description: Status pages to also publish the incident on (list_status_pages).

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the new title is written in. Defaults to the language of the current title; its other translations are kept.

remove_status_pages.description: Status pages to take the incident off.

title.description: New public headline. All its translations together must fit in 255 characters.

type.description: "incident" for degraded service, "outage" for services down.

name: update_status_page_incident
title: Edit status page incident
